title: Transfer Function and Stability of a Belt-Driven Rotating Machine
expert_review: Effective application of Laplace transforms to a multi-component mechanical system involving kinematic constraints.
learning_objectives: Derive the transfer function for a multi-inertia system with gear/pulley ratios
Apply the Laplace integration property to relate velocity and position in the s-domain
Simplify complex mechanical algebraic terms into standard first-order parameters
Analyze the impact of an integrator (pole at origin) on system stability
